_comment: Fixture-scale gold eval set (12 items) grounded in tests/fixtures/sample_doc*.json, spanning every question type the plan requires: text, table, figure, multi-hop, and adversarial/unanswerable. expected_chunk_ids were verified by actually running src/chunk/chunker.py over the fixtures (not guessed) -- see the chunk_id listing this was built from. This set exists to prove the eval harness itself is correct end-to-end; scripts/generate_gold_set.py documents how to scale it to ~120-150 items once the real corpus is parsed via notebooks/01_docling_parse_corpus.ipynb.
